questions.title: Operator Precedence
questions.question: What is the value of `2 + 3 * 4` in C?
questions.solution: Multiplication has higher precedence than addition. Thus, 2 + (3 * 4) = 14.

questions.title: Bitwise Operators
questions.question: For positive integers, what is the value of `5 & 3`?
questions.solution: 5 is 0101 and 3 is 0011 in binary. Their bitwise AND is 0001, which equals 1.

questions.title: Self-check
questions.question: Explain the difference between implicit conversion and explicit type casting.
questions.answer: Implicit conversion is performed automatically according to C's conversion rules. Explicit type casting is requested by the programmer using a cast expression.
questions.solution: For example, `double d = 5;` uses implicit conversion, whereas `double d = (double)x;` uses an explicit cast.
